reason: E1 and E2 describe DSA and a phonon-drag transition in the Co-containing NiCrFeCoMn alloy, but neither provides evidence for the Co-free variant or for Co's specific role in shifting the transition threshold. The key premises about the Co-free alloy's behavior and the comparative shift relative to the baseline are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Co-free FeNiCrMn HEA exhibits dynamic strain aging (DSA) at low-to-moderate strain rates
At high strain rates, dislocation motion becomes phonon-drag controlled
Absence of Co modulates solute atmosphere stability, shifting the DSA-to-phonon-drag transition threshold
CoCrFeMnNi baseline shows DSA and lower sensitivity to phonon drag
Transition manifests as sharper yield strength increase and greater serration amplitude above ~10³ s⁻¹
